program.intent: Parse date and time into a single epoch-microsecond integer and reconstruct with exact spacing and display format.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    year, month, day, sp1, hour, minute, second, millis = groups
    datetime_str = f"{year}-{month}-{day} {hour}:{minute}:{second}.{millis}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(datetime_str, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = layout[0]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    date_str = dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    time_str = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    millis_str = str(int(micros % 1000000 // 1000)).zfill(3)
    return date_str + (' ' * sp1_len) + time_str + ',' + millis_str
